overnight.note: James is overnight-only. His shifts are excluded from the swap engine entirely.

warehouse.note: Warehouse employees never cover store or security shifts.

security.note: Kaiden and Hunter can cover sales floor but are lower priority for store suggestions.

general.note: General pool can cross-cover any store location. Security coverage is last resort.

approvalFlow: All employees in the proposed chain must individually accept
Any single decline cancels the entire chain
Once all employees accept, request enters owner approval queue
Owner approves or denies with optional note
Approval writes updated shifts to schedule.json
